content: दशा .²1 The threads at the end of a piece of woven cloth, the fringe of a garment, the skirt, edge or hem of a garment; रक्तांशुकं पवनलोलदशं वहन्ती <ls>Mk. 1. 20</ls>; छिन्नाम् इवाम्बरपटस्य दशाः पतन्ति <ls n="Mk.">5. 4</ls>. .²2 The wick of a lamp; श्रेयोदशाग्रे स्फुरन् <ls>Bh. 3. 129</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 30</ls>. .²3 Age or time of life; see दशान्त below. .²4 A period or stage of life; as बाल्य, यौवन, <ab>&c.</ab>; दारक्रियायोग्यदशं च पुत्रम् <ls>R. 5. 40</ls>. .²5 A period in general. .²6 State, condition, circumstances; नीचैर्गच्छत्युपरि च दशा चक्रनेमिक्रमेण; <ls>Me. 111</ls>; विषमां हि दशां प्राप्य दैवं गर्हयते नरः <ls>H. 4. 3</ls>. .²7 State or condition of mind. .²8 The result of actions, fate. .²9 The aspect or position of planets (at birth). .²10 The mind, understanding.
